'''Servid Norn''' was the leader of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] faction, a rival to [[Plook Hartar]], and the brother of [[Harrid Norn]]. During a bet on whose pilot was faster, Norn put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Hartar's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Scranton Toon]], to ensure his brother would win the race and earn him sixty thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="BtDF" />
